study: Family D (calibration batch grouping) frozen-routing causal intervention

design.structure: 3 allocation seeds x 5 groupings; FR/FC paired by (seed, grouping); groupings nested in seeds (not 15 independent samples)

references.s0_ORIGINAL: Family A FR/FC_ORIGINAL natural + frozen runs (reused, not re-run)
references.s1_s2_ORIGINAL: historical natural PPL only (weights not stored): frozen not evaluable

reference_routing.source: Family A bf16_routing_manifest.json (reused exactly; not regenerated)

intervention: identical to Family A protocol: selected_experts <- BF16 reference indices in all 24 MoE layers; current router softmax probabilities gathered at forced indices; norm_topk_prob=False; FRT.make_forced_forward via moe_calib.inference_routing_override

parity.A_natural: every natural evaluation reproduces historical per-window NLL bitwise
parity.B_record_only: ('FR_s0_G20261111', 'FC_s2_G20261111'): recorder vs historical evaluator per-window bitwise; per-layer and final hidden-state hashes equal to the hook-free evaluator
parity.C_self_forcing: ('FR_s0_G20261111', 'FC_s2_G20261111'): forced with own natural indices -> bitwise identical
parity.D_bf16_self_forcing: BF16 forced with reference -> bitwise identical (per-window, per-token, layer hashes)
parity.E_frozen_dispatch: every frozen run: dispatch counts == BF16 reference; probabilities finite and model-dependent
parity.F_restoration: after each config: installed digest unchanged during eval, router weights unchanged, targets restored to pristine, no hooks/overrides; full non-target digest at start/end

metrics.delta: Delta[s,g] = PPL(FC,s,g) - PPL(FR,s,g) (positive = FR better); delta_g = Delta_nat - Delta_fro
metrics.primary: R_SD = pooled within-seed SD(Delta_fro) / pooled within-seed SD(Delta_nat); pooled = sqrt(mean_s SD_s^2), SD_s ddof=1 over the 5 groupings (historical moe_calib.cross_seed_grouping.variance_summary definition)
secondary: historical decision rule CS.decide under both regimes
metrics.reversal_R1: historical decision-rule definition: fraction of the 15 Delta with sign opposite to sign(M), M = mean of seed means, computed within each regime
metrics.reversal_R2: fp64 mechanism-table definition: Delta[s,g] sign vs the same seed's ORIGINAL-extraction Delta sign; frozen: seed 0 vs frozen ORIGINAL; seeds 1/2 frozen ORIGINAL unavailable -> reported as vs natural ORIGINAL sign, labelled mixed-regime
metrics.window_ci: full_depth_pilot.paired_bootstrap(FC, FR, tokens), n_boot 5000, seed 20261109, mean-NLL difference; same windows/resampling for both regimes; across-window != across-grouping
metrics.routing: set disagreement vs BF16; within-seed pairwise between groupings (10 pairs per seed x strategy); seed-0 vs ORIGINAL (Family A-compatible); margins p4-p5 as Family A
metrics.weights: pairwise within-seed groupings and seed-0 vs ORIGINAL: changed-element fraction, mean/median abs diff, rel Frobenius, per-layer/per-expert distribution, BF16 ULP distance; Family A order vs ORIGINAL with the same function for calibration

decision_rules.STRONG-COLLAPSE (A): R_SD <= 0.5 AND frozen R1 reversal count <= half the natural R1 count
decision_rules.WEAK-COLLAPSE (B): R_SD >= 0.9 AND frozen R1 count > half the natural R1 count
decision_rules.note: R_SD <= 0.5 is a descriptive screening threshold (as Family A), not a significance test; no additive variance decomposition
